steps.assert: screen_has('The Hearth') and screen_has('Next: 8 Gourdlings') and screen_has('20/20')
steps.msg: with nothing selected the info shows the hearth's lives and what the next wave brings, not prose

steps.assert: node('Countdown').text.begins_with('First wave in') and not node('Wave').visible
steps.msg: before the first wave the strip says when it comes, not 'Wave 0/8'
alone, the strip shows no Ready pips
the strip stops clicks only where it is painted, not under its cap's curl
the console art carries twice the texels it is drawn with
the horn shows the gold an early Ready pays, not a second countdown
upgrade does not apply with nothing selected
a command the gold cannot pay for greys and shows its cost in red

steps.assert: node('Notice').visible and node('Notice').text == 'Not enough gold' and node('BannerTitle').text != 'Not enough gold'
steps.msg: a rejected order is a small notice, not a banner
the notice sits over the column that names the selection and its cost, not at the screen's centre
an affordable one stays lit

steps.assert: screen_has('Level 1 · 0 kills') and screen_has('COOLDOWN') and not screen_has('EVERY')
steps.msg: a tower shows its level and kills under its name, and its cooldown by that name

steps.assert: screen_has('Level 2 · 1 kill') and not screen_has('1 kills')
steps.msg: one kill, not one kills
a fully upgraded tower's upgrade reads Max
big gold widens the strip leftwards, flush with the right edge
the console stops clicks only where it is painted
the wells come from the painter's layout.json
on a 1.5x screen the portrait renders at the screen's resolution, not the layout's
the horn has a tooltip, named Ready

steps.assert: node('Banner').visible and node('BannerTitle').text.begins_with('Wave 1') and node('Banner').size.x < 480 and node('Banner').get_global_rect().end.y <= 92
steps.msg: a title's band and rule fit the title and stay above the first row of towers
no stale tooltip over the end plate

steps.assert: screen_has('The hearth has gone dark') and screen_has('Fell in wave 1 of 8')
steps.msg: the end plate says how far the hollow held
at the end the hearth's line leaves the telling to the plate
and its empty line takes no room, so the numbers sit under the title
